name: Glycerol
aliases: E422, glycerol, glycerine, glycerin, glicerina, glicerol
what_is: A clear, viscous polyol liquid used as a humectant and sweetener.
why_botia: Glycerol attracts and retains water, which is why it keeps baked goods and gummies moist. In the European Union, since 2023, food-grade E422 can only be obtained from vegetable oils and fats; in other markets other production methods exist, and the label does not say which. JECFA did not see a need to set a limit.
can_1: Detect E422 or Glycerol/Glycerine on scanned labels.
can_2: Activate texture, animal, and Muslim choice layers.
cannot_1: Verify if obtained from animal or vegetable fat sources.
cannot_2: Detect 3-MCPD contaminants above the 0.1 mg/kg limit.
title: Glycerol
description: A clear, viscous polyol liquid used as a humectant and sweetener.
